name: What materials are used for deck structural repairs?

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for deck structural repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: For deck structural repairs, we typically use pressure-treated lumber for its resistance to rot and insects, which is essential for components like joists, beams, and posts. We also utilize high-quality fasteners, such as hot-dipped galvanized or stainless steel, to prevent corrosion and ensure long-term stability. The choice of materials adheres to local building codes and industry best practices to ensure durability and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use pressure-treated lumber for rot resistance and high-quality galvanized or stainless steel fasteners for durability and safety.
